findings.claim: FT-1 done_when is owner-free and falsifiable, baseline is measured with cited source ('#3986'), but the first-green proof is vacuous because it only tests gpu-q, while Q2 notes that bare-flock users bypass gpu-q.

FT-2 done_when is owner-free and falsifiable, baseline is measured with cited source ('#3986\'s 97 % was taken by hand'), and the first-green proof fails when the row is not done ('0-sample window exits non-zero').

FT-3 done_when is owner-free and falsifiable, baseline is measured with cited source ('(#3986 P3)'), and first-green proof fails when the row is not done ('Mutant: the CPU leg wrapped back in the lock ⇒ that row is RED').

FT-4 done_when is owner-free and falsifiable, baseline is measured with cited source ('(#3986 comment)'). The first-green proof is vacuous because checking that 'the stage refuses when the pre-screen card\'s compute capability differs' only validates the runner's guardrails, not that the pre-screen risk cells actually executed on an idle card.
FT-5 done_when is owner-free and falsifiable, and first-green proof fails when not done. However, the baseline is uncited and only asserted as 'one host runs its whole column serially.'
FT-6 done_when is owner-free and falsifiable, and first-green proof fails when not done. However, the baseline is uncited and asserted as 'a binary mutex; no concurrent run has ever been compared.'

FT-7 done_when is owner-free and falsifiable, and first-green proof fails when not done. However, the baseline is uncited and asserted, only noting 'the q4k.apr cell went RED while it was still waiting for the lock.'

FT-8 done_when is owner-free and falsifiable, baseline is measured with cited source ('measured at origin/main 49fe19c28'), and first-green proof fails when not done ('fails when a target is neither compiled... nor listed').

FT-9 done_when is owner-free and falsifiable, baseline is measured with cited source ('the drain was fixed in cab272e5d', 'lines at 49fe19c28'), and first-green proof fails when not done ('each new self-test proven RED on its own mutant').
FT-10 done_when is owner-free and falsifiable, and first-green proof fails when not done. The baseline is honestly [U] as noted in the baselines section ('X1 baseline: [U]').

FT-11 done_when is owner-free and falsifiable, and baseline is measured with a cited source ('open at 0.69.1\'s freeze (13:00Z 2026-09-23)'). The first-green proof is vacuous because the structured 'first-green proof' section is entirely missing from the plan for this row.

FT-12 done_when is owner-free and falsifiable, and baseline is measured with a cited source ('from #3997'). The first-green proof is vacuous because the thresholds are currently '[U] until aprender-cb\'s sizing lands', meaning the gate cannot fail against a non-existent threshold today.
Missing #3986 P2 from the FT rows. The epic context cites #3986 (GPU lock efficiency P1-P5), but only P1, P3, P4, and P5 are addressed in the plan (FT-1, FT-3, FT-6, FT-4, FT-5). P2 is missing.
